findings.title: Absence of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA)
findings.gap_ref: Ship Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) with the appliance
findings.detail: The project lacks a draft or template for the RoPA, which is a mandatory requirement under GDPR Article 30. Without this, the organization cannot demonstrate accountability or provide transparency regarding what personal data is being processed.
findings.action: Immediately draft a RoPA template and populate it with all identified data processing operations.

findings.title: Undocumented Data Flows and Third-Party Data Sources
findings.gap_ref: The queryable corpus is 58 enriched listings across three agencies (Agency A, Agency B, Agency C) in SQLite + ChromaDB
findings.detail: There is no evidence of the full corpus or the presence of Agency A/Agency B data in the logs, creating an undocumented data flow. Processing data from external agencies without verified data flows or documented lawful basis poses a significant compliance risk.
findings.action: Map and document the end-to-end data flow for all three agencies, including the source, method of collection, and legal basis for each.

findings.title: Unverified Legal Entity and Controller Identity
findings.gap_ref: Registration secured for Startup OLÉ Marbella
findings.detail: The lack of legal or registration documents makes it impossible to verify the identity of the Data Controller. In the event of a data breach, the absence of a verifiable legal entity complicates the legal responsibility and notification process.
findings.action: Provide official business registration certificates to establish the legal identity of the controller.

findings.title: Unmapped Jurisdictional and DPA Updates
findings.gap_ref: DPA §11.3 — Málaga confirmed, jurisdiction note updated
findings.detail: Updates to jurisdiction and Data Processing Agreements (DPA) are occurring without being reflected in the project commitments. This creates a gap between actual processing operations and the documented legal framework governing data transfers.
findings.action: Reconcile all technical updates regarding jurisdiction and DPA templates with the central compliance documentation.

summary: The project currently exhibits critical compliance failures, specifically regarding the lack of a RoPA and undocumented data flows from third-party agencies. There is a dangerous disconnect between technical implementation and the documented legal basis for processing, which undermines the principle of accountability.
